title: Mutex lock uses .unwrap(), panicking on a poisoned lock
evidence: src/lib.rs:93 `db.lock().unwrap()` (also :106, :120, :129, :143) — a panic in any handler while holding the lock poisons it, then every subsequent request panics
suggestion: Handle the PoisonError (recover the guard or return 500) instead of unwrap
